intro: Link a task to a pull request and its status follows the work: opening the pull request starts it, merging moves it to review. A deployment never completes a task; only a person marks it Completed. Only tasks whose pull request is linked are touched, never on a locked project, and every change is recorded in the audit trail as the GitHub connection.
In the GitHub repository settings, add a webhook with this address, content type application/json, the secret from when you connected, and the events Pull requests and Deployment statuses.
